summary: Inbox sends and persists a note on every named answer option, including notes on options that were not selected. Stored answers and asking agents retain each note exactly once, and a named dismiss option sends its own note as the selected answer text.

replay.detail: No claim replay changes; existing answers remain readable.

schema.detail: Answer inputs and stored typed answers add optional option_notes entries with a named option id and nonblank text. This changes the typed answer record schema, but does not change database tables or the storage schema version.

rules.detail: No checkpoint-rule or digest changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The API and generated Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients accept optional option_notes. The TUI requires person-answer-option-notes version 1 before sending notes on other options, refusing the send and retaining drafts on older daemons. Answers without these notes omit the field. Older strict schema validators may reject extended answers; summaries retain all notes for tolerant readers. Delegated completion claims must include every option note in their summary.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected service interruption.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or re-pairing required.

recovery.detail: Refused answers retain the selected option and every note. Inbox option notes are saved as drafts across TUI restarts and retained for 30 days, like other drafts.
